bases.name: Kitchener Paramedic Base downtown
bases.notes: Current roster omits direction. Regional 2016 energy inventory identifies EMS Weber & Water as 100 Weber Street West. Do not assume these are two stations. Coordinates use the station-specific active City of Kitchener Emergency Services GIS point, rather than the whole civic-address parcel. Current service roster establishes current operational status; GIS location source dates can be older. GIS point is labeled 104 Weber Street West; the regional energy inventory uses 100 Weber Street West and current regional service roster uses 100 Water Street. These nearby labels are retained as an unresolved address discrepancy, not counted as separate bases.

bases.name: Kitchener Paramedic Base doon
bases.notes: Current regional roster abbreviates to 299 Doon Valley; official regional public-health notice verifies street suffix Drive. Coordinates use the station-specific active City of Kitchener Emergency Services GIS point, rather than the whole civic-address parcel. Current service roster establishes current operational status; GIS location source dates can be older. GIS street label says Doon Valley Road; current public regional address uses Doon Valley Drive. The station-specific point lies on the college site.

bases.name: Kitchener Fire Station 8 and housing development
bases.shortName: Kitchener Fire Station 8 and housing development
bases.notes: Detailed design, permitting and site-plan review in September 2026; site mobilization and servicing preparation underway. Municipal project page targets main building construction in Q2/spring 2027 and station opening in 2028. Earlier 2026 opening forecast is superseded. Two apparatus bays; housing component has a later schedule. Coordinate is the official base address point for 450 King Street East within the development site; future station entrance is not verified.
